text:
Items in the first photo: two fried eggs, two slices of wholegrain toast, two small spread portions (likely butter/jam), and a cup of milky coffee (latte or cappuccino).

Estimated energy and mass of what was eaten:
- Eggs: 2 fried eggs at about 90 kcal and 50 g each come to 180 kcal and 100 g.
- Toast: 2 slices at about 90 kcal and 35 g each come to 180 kcal and 70 g.
- Spreads: two small portions of about 7 g each come to about 100 kcal and 14 g (butter at about 50 kcal each). The packets look like they were used, since the tubs are empty with foil left over.
- Coffee: the cup looks almost fully drunk, with only a little residue left. A latte of about 250 ml is roughly 100 kcal. I assumed about 220 g was consumed.

Total: 180 + 180 + 100 + 100 = 560 kcal. Mass: 100 + 70 + 14 + 220 = about 404 g.
